title: Corrigendum to “Pedicled and free latissimus dorsi flaps in oral and oropharyngeal reconstruction: comparison of outcomes” [Int J Oral Maxillofacial Surg (2026) Article in press]
html: The authors regret that two contributing authors, Lina Lindhorst and André Eckardt, were omitted from the author list of the original article. The correct author list is: Rüdiger M. Zimmerer, Johannes Häfner, Marie Salge, Philippe Korn, Lina Lindhorst, André Eckardt, Nils-Claudius Gellrich, and Michael T. Neuhaus. The affiliations of Lina Lindhorst and André Eckardt are with the Department of Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, Hannover Medical School, Hannover, Germany. This correction concerns the authorship information only; the scientific content and conclusions remain unchanged.
